description: Compare one kind of dish across Sydney menus, or named venues side by side, by printed price, allergen status and distance. Examples: dish_type 'burger' with free_of ['gluten'] near 'Manly' (cheapest or nearest gluten-free burgers, with the price spread); venues ['Grill'd', 'Betty's Burgers'] with dish_type 'burger' (how many burgers each serves, how many fit, the cheapest). Prices are only what the menu prints, never estimated. Every answer links the same comparison as a table on the site (page).

dish_type.description: A kind of dish: burger, pizza, pasta, curry, sushi, steak, dumplings, tacos, dessert, breakfast, ... Required unless venues are given.

free_of.description: Optional. Allergens or diets every dish must be free of (by default or on request): gluten, dairy, nuts, egg, soy, sesame, shellfish, fish, vegetarian, vegan; 'coeliac' means gluten.

max_price.description: Optional. Highest printed price in AUD dollars; dishes with no printed price are left out when set.

near.description: Optional place name: a Sydney suburb or region, such as 'Manly' or 'Inner West', to measure distance from. Coordinates as 'lat,lng' also work.

sort.description: Optional. price (default, cheapest first), distance (needs near; default when near is given) or fit (free by default before on request).

venues.description: Optional. Two or more venue names to compare side by side ('Grill'd', 'Betty's Burgers'). The nearest branch to `near` is used for chains.

name: compare
title: Compare dishes or venues
